query:
MATCH p = TRAIL (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(t:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Used documented TRAIL, edge quantifier, nodes(PATH), and transform(LIST, lambda). Plain RETURN preserves duplicate rows for distinct parallel-edge paths; node IDs retain traversal order. Static reference review only; no database execution.
